verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance runs some fixed workflows in the background. It files annual reports automatically in all states as they come due through direct secretary-of-state integrations, and it propagates Company Profile updates to records across jurisdictions. Users can also customize annual report reminders. These are vendor-defined automations rather than ones users design; the OAuth client-credentials API is only a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a user-configurable automation or workflow builder, user-defined triggers and schedules, agent-driven background tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the automatic filing works as claimed.
